# Google Cloud Cluster Toolkit (gcluster) — Full Blueprint & Module Reference (llms-full.txt)

> Auto-generated by `tools/catalog-gen`. DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY. Regenerate with: `go run ./tools/catalog-gen`.
> Complete single-file schema of all blueprints in `examples/` and `community/examples/` and all embedded modules in `modules/` and `community/modules/`.

## Essential Rules

1. **Install or build `./gcluster`:**
   - Pre-built bundle (includes `./gcluster` and `examples/`): `mkdir -p cluster-toolkit && curl -L https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/cluster-toolkit/releases/latest/download/gcluster_bundle_linux_amd64.tgz | tar -xz -C cluster-toolkit && cd cluster-toolkit`
   - Source checkout: `git clone https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/cluster-toolkit.git && cd cluster-toolkit && make`
2. **CLI Inspection (`./gcluster explain`):** `./gcluster explain`, `./gcluster explain <specs...>` (e.g. `./gcluster explain slurm a3u lustre`), or `./gcluster explain <blueprint_or_module_path>`.
3. **Customize via `deployment.yaml` (`-d`):** Pass overrides (`project_id`, `deployment_name`, `region`, `zone`, node counts, reservations) via `./gcluster deploy -d <deployment.yaml> <blueprint.yaml>`. Validate/expand without deploying via `./gcluster expand <blueprint.yaml> -d <deployment.yaml> -o expanded.yaml`. Never edit generated `.tf` files.
4. **Reservation Syntax in `deployment.yaml`:**
   - **GKE (`reservation_affinity` in `examples/gke-a3-highgpu/gke-a3-highgpu.yaml`, `examples/gke-a3-megagpu/gke-a3-megagpu.yaml`, `examples/gke-a3-ultragpu/gke-a3-ultragpu.yaml`, `examples/gke-a4/gke-a4.yaml`, `examples/gke-g4/gke-g4.yaml`, `examples/gke-h4d/gke-h4d.yaml`, `examples/gke-tpu-7x/gke-tpu-7x-advanced.yaml`, `examples/gke-tpu-7x/gke-tpu-7x.yaml`, `examples/gke-tpu-v5p/gke-tpu-v5p.yaml`, `examples/gke-tpu-v6e/gke-tpu-v6e-advanced.yaml`, `examples/gke-tpu-v6e/gke-tpu-v6e.yaml`):** `reservation_affinity: {consume_reservation_type: SPECIFIC_RESERVATION, specific_reservations: [{name: <RESERVATION_NAME>}]}`
   - **GKE blueprints using `reservation` (`examples/gke-a4x-max-bm/gke-a4x-max-bm.yaml`, `examples/gke-a4x/gke-a4x.yaml`, `examples/gke-g4-confidential/gke-g4-confidential.yaml`, `examples/gke-tpu-v4/gke-tpu-v4.yaml`, `examples/gke-tpu-v5e/gke-tpu-v5e.yaml`):** `reservation: <RESERVATION_NAME>`
   - **Slurm / VM reservation variables (`<VAR>: <RESERVATION_NAME>`):** `a3_reservation_name` (`examples/machine-learning/a3-highgpu-8g/a3high-slurm-blueprint.yaml`), `a3mega_reservation_name` (`examples/machine-learning/a3-megagpu-8g/a3mega-slurm-blueprint.yaml`, `examples/machine-learning/a3-megagpu-8g/a3mega-slurm-gcsfuse-lssd-blueprint.yaml`), `a3u_reservation_name` (`examples/machine-learning/a3-ultragpu-8g/a3ultra-slurm-blueprint.yaml`, `examples/machine-learning/a3-ultragpu-8g/a3ultra-vm.yaml`), `a4h_reservation_name` (`examples/machine-learning/a4-highgpu-8g/a4high-slurm-blueprint.yaml`, `examples/machine-learning/a4-highgpu-8g/a4high-vm.yaml`), `a4x_max_reservation_name` (`examples/machine-learning/a4x-maxgpu-4g-metal/a4xmax-bm-slurm-blueprint.yaml`), `a4x_reservation_name` (`examples/machine-learning/a4x-highgpu-4g/a4xhigh-slurm-blueprint.yaml`), `compute_reservation_name` (`examples/ml-slurm-g4-vgpu.yaml`, `examples/ml-slurm-g4.yaml`), `h4d_reservation_name` (`examples/hpc-slurm-h4d/hpc-slurm-h4d.yaml`), `reservation_name` (`examples/h4d-vm.yaml`, `examples/machine-learning/a4x-highgpu-4g/a4x-vm.yaml`), `tpu_reservation_name` (`examples/machine-learning/tpu7x-standard-4t/tpu7x-slurm-blueprint.yaml`)
